title: 4.10 What Time Is It?
unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, describe a short daily routine, ask and answer Do you...? questions, and say the day and the time.
goal: Ask and answer the time, read whole hours, and distinguish morning, afternoon, evening and night using a.m./p.m. context.
grammar_function: What time is it? It is + number + o'clock; in the morning / in the afternoon / in the evening / at night; It is + number + a.m./p.m. No routines or activity-at-time statements.
prerequisite: Units 2â€“3 numbers 1â€“12, it/is; 4.3 in/the; 4.5 in the morning. No routine verbs are required.
speaking_outcome: Take both roles in a time exchange and give a clear whole-hour answer with its day period.
